name: Splashtop
description: A commercial remote access and support platform aimed at MSPs and IT teams — strong on Windows/macOS performance and enterprise security add-ons, but Linux (especially Wayland) support lags noticeably behind.

Wayland Unattended Access.comment: No documented system-level Wayland integration; current capability is limited to attended, portal-confirmed access

Tailscale Support.comment: No native integration; Splashtop uses its own relay infrastructure instead

Multi-Monitor Support.comment: "Multi-to-multi monitor" support, though some reviewers note switching between monitors feels slow

Multi-User Sessions.comment: Connects to one existing session per device, not isolated multi-user terminal sessions

4:4:4 Chroma Subsampling.comment: Not documented; likely standard lossy video compression rather than full-chroma preservation

Frame Rate (FPS).comment: Marketed as high-FPS/4K-capable streaming, among the smoother options in this category

Session Recording.comment: Available from the Pro tier up; cloud-based session recording is an Enterprise-tier feature

Wake-on-LAN.comment: Marketed as "remote wake" on Business Access plans

Pre-Login Access.comment: The Splashtop Streamer runs as a background service, enabling unattended pre-login access

No Account Required.comment: Access is tied to a licensed Splashtop account on both ends

Windows: Host.comment: The most mature and best-performing host platform

Linux X11: Host.comment: Possible but described by reviewers as requiring workarounds and technical skill

Linux Wayland: Host.comment: No documented native unattended Wayland support

Linux: Client.comment: Limited compared to the Windows/macOS/mobile clients

Android: Host.comment: Unattended Android access is specifically an Enterprise-tier feature

Web Browser: Client.comment: Splashtop Business offers browser-based session access in addition to the native apps

Free Tier.comment: No permanent free plan; only a time-limited free trial is offered

Personal: Monthly.comment: Business Access Solo plan, billed annually at $72/year

Team / Business: Monthly.comment: Business Access Pro: $99/user/year, includes remote reboot, session recording, session sharing

Enterprise.comment: SSO/SAML, SIEM logging, IP whitelisting, cloud recording; SOS support plans run ~$22-33/technician/mo
